name: AI Sheet Automation — Claude + Google Sheets + Slack

nodes.name: Google Sheets Trigger
nodes.notes: Polls every minute for new rows. Replace YOUR_GOOGLE_SHEET_ID_HERE with your actual Sheet ID from the URL.

nodes.name: Claude AI — Analyze Text
nodes.notes: Calls claude-sonnet-4-6. The credential must be HTTP Header Auth with Name=x-api-key and Value=your key.

nodes.name: Parse Claude Response
nodes.notes: Parses the JSON Claude returns. Falls back to regex extraction if Claude accidentally wraps output in markdown.

nodes.name: Update Google Sheet
nodes.notes: Writes Summary and Category back to the same row using row_number as the key.

nodes.name: Send Slack Alert
nodes.notes: Posts to #automations. Make sure your Slack Bot has chat:write scope and is invited to the channel.
